the Korean ECV18 isolate is closely related to the Metcalf reference strain at the amino acid sequence level, and that it is sensitive to amantadine and ribavirin.

the genetic characterization and the antiviral activity of five common antivirals for a Korean ECV18 isolate, the first report of this virus in Korea.
the molecular characterization of ECV 18 and the antiviral activity of the five antivirals.
the antiviral activities of the five drugs against the Korean EVC 18 isolate.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the Korean ECV18 isolate is a unique variant of the Metcalf ECV18 strain.
amantadine and ribavirin are the only antiviral drugs that are active against the Korean EVC 5 and 18 isolates.
the antiviral activity of the five common antivirals against the ECV18 strain is similar to that against the ECV5 strain.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the Korean ECV18 isolate has a similar genetic and antiviral characteristics to the ECV5 strain.
the Korean ECV18 and ECV5 isolates were genetically similar and had similar antiviral activity to the five common drugs.
the antiviral activity of the five common drugs against ECV18 isolate was the same as that against ECV 5 isolate.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the Korean ECV18 isolate is highly similar to the ECV5 and that the five common antivirals have no cytotoxic effect on Vero cells.
the antiviral activity of amantadine and ribavirin is not affected by the amino acid sequence of the 2BC junction.
amantadine and ribavirin may be effective in controlling ECV 18 outbreaks.
